view_frame: The drawing presents two views in third-angle projection. The upper view is the Front view, showing the XZ plane (width and height). The lower view is the Top view, showing the XY plane (width and depth). The world origin is at the bottom-front-left corner of the box. X is width (left to right), Y is depth (front to back), and Z is height (bottom to top).
